description: Navigate a tab to URL. Pass tab_id from browser_tabs to reuse an existing tab; omit or leave empty to use the active control tab. Returns tab_id in results[0].tab_id.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

tab_id.description: Optional. browser_tabs targetId to navigate in place.

name: browser_navigate
